title: Final Surface Temp
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the surface temperature T_s as 22.5 K.

title: Final Central Temp
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the central temperature T_c as 372 K.

title: Heat Balance Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive and correctly apply the heat balance equation relating surface temperature to internal heat generation.

title: Heat Conduction Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the heat conduction equation in spherical coordinates.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the heat conduction equation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as the factor of 1/3 in the heat balance equation, are included.
